title: Boundary and fragment privacy patterns before self-scan
trigger_preconditions: the privacy scanner scans its own source
a short secret prefix can occur inside ordinary words
failure_signature: The first staged privacy review failed closed on a benign skill-name substring and on its own literal local-path expression.
candidate_workaround: For self-scanning privacy tools, bound token-like credential patterns and fragment forbidden path literals without weakening the compiled expression.
recurrence_guard: Run a known-benign indexed-name regression and self-scan the scanner source before accepting a zero-hit receipt.
rollback: Keep the privacy gate failed and retain all hits if pattern tightening would remove a genuine forbidden match.
scope_boundary: Same-owner bounded operational recovery only; no scientific, authority, production, accessibility-complete, security-complete, or independent-reproduction credit.
